name: Asao Misato
source:
The protagonist's biological older sister, who works as an office lady.

She and Masaharu have a good sibling relationship, and she is particularly affectionate toward her younger brother.

She works as an administrative employee at a company within the prefecture and is highly trusted as a capable and reliable member of staff.

However, she is also aware that some of the younger female employees privately regard her as an o-tsubone — an older, long-serving female employee who has become something of a workplace fixture.

She has always had terrible luck with men.

The men she has dated have included domestic abusers, gambling addicts drowning in debt, and other assorted losers. In other words, she has a tendency to fall for what the Japanese call damenzu — hopeless men.

She doesn't want to admit it to herself, but she also has a tendency to become emotionally dependent on men.

Longing to be loved, she repeatedly finds herself devoting herself to even the most worthless men.

On the surface, she pretends that everything is fine, but deep down, she feels increasingly anxious about her younger brother getting married.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
